audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed on every row: full had Skill x5 then Aurelion Sol x2; content and packet had Ryze 7/7 — and the packet itself flags Ryze 7/7 as contradicting a 47.66% win rate.
audit.why: The kit adjudicates it: Aurelion Sol's early Breath of Light is short-ranged, stack-poor and channel-interruptible, so Ryze owns levels 1-6; his Stardust economy and 120s Falling Star make the item-spike rows his, which is the only chart consistent with Ryze winning under 50% overall. Full already had Aurelion Sol on rows 5-6.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..4].side moved Skill -> Ryze (whys and ratings rewritten); content win[5..6] moved Ryze -> Aurelion Sol with whys[5..6] and spikes[2].text rewritten to match. Result: both layers read Ryze x5, Aurelion Sol x2.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text used the fabricated name 'Sing of the Cosmos'; spikes[2] claimed first item is yours while the full layer marks it Aurelion Sol's.
audit.why: His R is Falling Star / The Skies Descend per the kit. First-item timing is when his banked Stardust starts landing.
audit.corrected: Name killed; spikes[2] rewritten as contested with the shove-and-roam plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never says that Rune Prison cancels his Q and W channels — the decisive interaction in this lane (missingInteractions); breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; the Singularity execute/percent-health note and the hold-Flash-for-the-flight-cutoff warning were also absent.
audit.why: Kit flags: Breath of Light and Astral Flight are channels any CC cancels; Singularity does percent-health damage and executes below a threshold; Ryze has no dash, so a flight across his retreat path is lethal.
audit.corrected: W-cancels-the-channel now in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d with real numbers (Flight 22s, Singularity 12s, Falling Star 120s).

audit.whatIsWrong: No durations anywhere despite the packet flagging zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Astral Flight's 22s rank-1 downtime defines the whole trade rhythm.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.

edits.before: He out-ranges your combo for five levels — farm the Tear, dodge the big spell, and let the item curve flip the lane.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the thesis across the map. Nothing else fits Ryze.

notes: The packet's own levelChart (Ryze 7/7) is flagged as contradictory by the packet's defects line; I resolved the chart to Ryze x5 / Aurelion Sol x2, which both layers now share and which matches the 47.66% win rate and his stack-scaling kit. Confidence Medium on that adjudication — if the user prefers the packet chart verbatim, rows 5-6 need reverting on BOTH layers together. Fabricated ability name 'Sing of the Cosmos' killed (real R: Falling Star / The Skies Descend). Missing interactions all covered: W cancels his Q/W channels (cooldowns, dos, donts), Singularity execute noted in cooldowns; hold-Flash-for-the-wall could not fit any field within the length band and is recorded here — Astral Flight across your retreat path is lethal because Ryze has no dash. Content late/spikes[3] remain conditional ('as long as you denied stacks'), which is consistent with the new rows.
